en.headline: Tai Hang Fire Dragon Dance returns this week for Mid-Autumn
en.dek: The 67-metre incense-lit dragon will parade through Tai Hang streets from 24 to 26 September, with live broadcasts and a gala night on the festival day itself.
body: The traditional Tai Hang Fire Dragon Dance will take place from Thursday to Saturday this week as part of Hong Kong’s Mid-Autumn celebrations, organisers and the Leisure and Cultural Services Department have confirmed.

Performers will carry a 67-metre dragon illuminated by thousands of incense sticks through the streets of Tai Hang on 24, 25 and 26 September. On the evening of 25 September, the main festival night, the dance is scheduled after a gala programme, with earlier live broadcasts of the performance also planned for the surrounding nights.

The ritual, rooted in local Hakka tradition and long regarded as a way to drive away misfortune and bring good fortune, draws large crowds each year. Visitors are advised to arrive early, follow on-site crowd control measures and avoid bringing prohibited items such as naked-flame lanterns or glass bottles into the area.

The dance forms part of a wider city programme of Mid-Autumn lantern displays, including the ongoing International Lantern Spectacular and Mid-Autumn Lantern Carnival at Victoria Park, which continue until 27 September.

zh.headline: 大坑舞火龍本周上演 中秋三晚巡遊
zh.dek: 67米長香火龍將於9月24至26日在大坑街巷巡遊，中秋正日另有晚會及直播安排。
body: 傳統大坑舞火龍將於本周四至周六舉行，作為香港中秋節慶祝活動一部分，康文署及相關籌辦單位已確認詳情。
表演者將於9月24、25及26日手持長約67米、插滿香枝的火龍，穿越大坑多條街道。中秋正日9月25日晚上，火龍巡遊安排在晚會節目之後進行，其餘兩晚亦有直播安排。
這項源自本地客家傳統的儀式，多年來被視為驅邪納福的習俗，每年均吸引大量市民及遊客到場。當局提醒市民提早到達、遵從現場人流管制措施，並勿攜帶明火燈籠或玻璃瓶等違禁物品進入範圍。
舞火龍亦是全城中秋綵燈活動的一部分，維園國際中秋綵燈匯及中秋綵燈嘉年華則繼續展出至9月27日。
